salary_gate.description: Salary is an eliminatory filter. Any position below the configured monthly USD floor is auto-discarded. If a range is published, the lower bound is evaluated. If no salary is published, the position is not discarded: it is flagged for validation before moving forward.

categories.recommended_action: Apply immediately, prioritize over the rest.
Apply only if no better options are in progress.

criteria.name: Profile alignment
criteria.description: Closeness of the role to the user's target roles (defined in their professional profile). Highest-weight criterion after the salary gate.

hints.5: Exact or near-exact match with one of the user's target roles.
hints.4: Very close role with a strong overlap in core responsibilities and skills.
hints.3: Related but partial fit; overlaps in some responsibilities or domain.
hints.2: Weak fit; mostly tasks outside the user's target direction.
hints.1: Misaligned with the search or requires a profile the user explicitly avoids.

criteria.name: Remote modality
criteria.description: Degree of real remote work and timezone compatibility from the user's location.

hints.5: Truly remote from the user's location with reasonable timezone overlap.
hints.4: Remote with compatible timezone/geographic restrictions, or occasional travel.
hints.3: Very flexible hybrid, or regional remote with minor compatibility doubts.
hints.2: Demanding hybrid, unclear remote policy, or frequent presence required.
hints.1: On-site, mandatory relocation, or incompatible timezone.

criteria.name: Seniority and growth
criteria.description: Real possibility of growing in responsibility and career, not just compensation.

hints.5: Level and responsibilities fit well, with a clear growth path toward the user's target direction.
hints.4: Good seniority match with relevant learning and probable growth.
hints.3: Reachable but demanding, or growth possible though not explicit.
hints.2: Seniority above/below the profile, or limited growth.
hints.1: Far too senior, deep-specialist, or career path misaligned.

criteria.name: Company and stability
criteria.description: Reputation, funding, verifiable track record and stability of the company.

hints.5: Trustworthy company, funded or profitable, with clear traction and verifiable reputation.
hints.4: Solid company in an aligned industry with positive signals.
hints.3: Valid company but limited information or moderate stability.
hints.2: Mixed signals, low transparency, or questionable traction.
hints.1: Clear negative signals, risky reputation, or unverifiable company.
